name: string-view-over-temporary
description: A borrowed string_view must not outlive temporary or local string storage
trap: The model keeps string_view because it looks cheaper, overlooking that operator+ creates a temporary std::string whose storage dies at return.
criteria: Identifies that the returned std::string_view dangles
Returns an owning std::string or otherwise introduces storage with an explicit lifetime
Does not claim that binding string_view extends the temporary lifetime

name: unique-owner-not-shared
description: Compilation trouble does not justify replacing exclusive ownership with shared ownership
trap: The model changes every unique_ptr to shared_ptr so both containers can copy it, creating shared lifetime where the requirements name one owner.
criteria: Keeps the server as the unique owner
Makes the registry a non-owning observer with a lifetime tied to the server
Does not introduce std::shared_ptr merely to make copying compile
Explains the invalidation or destruction contract of the observer

name: move-mistakes
description: std::move is not added to const sources or returned locals
trap: The model praises both std::move calls, missing that the return can inhibit NRVO and moving from a const value normally selects a copy.
criteria: Removes const from the by-value sink parameter before moving from it, or explains why the API should change
Explains that std::move is a cast and the selected operation performs the move
Does not assume a moved-from string is necessarily empty

name: contiguous-view-cpp17
description: A C++17 API does not accidentally introduce std::span or a home-grown replacement
prompt: Design a C++17 function that computes a checksum over a borrowed contiguous byte buffer. This is one internal helper; the project has no GSL or other span dependency.
trap: The model recommends std::span as modern C++, silently requiring C++20, or writes an incomplete custom span abstraction for one helper.
criteria: Does not use std::span under C++17
Uses a pointer plus size for this isolated contiguous-buffer helper
Keeps the pointer non-owning and documents the required extent
Does not add a third-party dependency or custom span for one internal function
